title: Four cells from one
hook: Predict the result, then reveal the sequence.

knows: DNA and RNA are sequences of chemical building blocks.
doesNotKnow: Meiosis separates homologues and then sister chromatids. With normal separation, each of the four haploid cells in this 2n = 2 model receives one chromosome. Crossing over is omitted here.

misconception: The original sequence and the resulting sequence must have the same interpretation.
objective: Meiosis separates homologues and then sister chromatids. With normal separation, each of the four haploid cells in this 2n = 2 model receives one chromosome. Crossing over is omitted here.

claims.text: Question, answer, diagram and explanation: A diploid model cell has one pair of homologous chromosomes (2n = 2). After meiosis, how many chromosomes are in each of its four cells? Meiosis separates homologues and then sister chromatids. With normal separation, each of the four haploid cells in this 2n = 2 model receives one chromosome. Crossing over is omitted here.
Recall: A diploid model cell has 2n = 4. After normal meiosis, how many chromosomes are in each haploid cell? For 2n = 4 the haploid number is n = 2.
The figure is a simplified model and is not to scale.

recall.question: A diploid model cell has 2n = 4. After normal meiosis, how many chromosomes are in each haploid cell?
recall.why: For 2n = 4 the haploid number is n = 2.
